func judge(_ want: String, focused: String?, main: String?, canon: [String: String] = [:]) -> Bool {
    focusedDocumentMismatch(want: want, shown: { name in name == "AXFocusedWindow" ? focused : main },
        canonical: { p in canon[p] ?? p.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping }).isEmpty
}
let out: [String: Bool] = [
    "the approved file in both windows": judge("/a/note.txt", focused: "/a/note.txt", main: "/a/note.txt"),
    "same name, other folder focused": judge("/a/note.txt", focused: "/b/note.txt", main: "/a/note.txt"),
    "main window shows another file": judge("/a/note.txt", focused: "/a/note.txt", main: "/b/note.txt"),
    "focused window unreadable": judge("/a/note.txt", focused: nil, main: "/a/note.txt"),
    "decomposed name reported (TextEdit)": judge("COMPOSED", focused: "DECOMPOSED", main: "DECOMPOSED"),
    "approved path not canonical": judge("/a/../a/note.txt", focused: "/a/note.txt", main: "/a/note.txt",
                                          canon: ["/a/../a/note.txt": "/a/note.txt"]),
    "relative path": judge("note.txt", focused: "note.txt", main: "note.txt"),
]
print(String(data: try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.sortedKeys]), encoding: .utf8)!)
